title: Report an issue
covers: Report an issue from any screen

steps.say: When something is wrong in SimplyFile, anyone signed in - a partner, a manager, an article - reports it from any screen. No email: the report and its answer stay inside the portal. This is Reported issues, where they are answered.
Open the account menu and pick Report an issue. It works the same on every screen.
A short header, what went wrong, and a screenshot if it helps - browse, drop or paste. The screen it came from is attached on its own.

do.text: Reconcile does not open for one client
On Reconcile, Ramesh Iyer's 26AS shows the spinner and never loads.

steps.say: Send report, and it lands in Reported issues with a count in the menu for whoever answers. Here one is already waiting - sent by someone in a firm.
In Reported issues it sits at the top - who sent it, from where, and what is wrong.
Open it, read it with its screenshot, write a reply the sender will see, and resolve it.

do.text: Thank you - his 26AS file was cut short. Upload it again and it opens.

steps.say: The next time the sender opens the portal, the answer waits as a banner at the top - and every report, with its status and answer, stays in the account menu under My reports and feedback.
Every limit, every status and who may answer live in chips the owner can change.
